fields.what_it_is: iFuse-3D, The SI Joint Implant Allowing Bone Ingrowth, Ongrowth and Through Growth. 3D-Printed “Bone-Like” Surface may enhance osteointegration. Self-Harvesting Bone Technology: iFuse-3D captures bone during implantation that may be deposited into the implant. Surgeons can pack the implant with autograft or allograft material, 1-3 cc depending on implant size. Triangular design has 6X more rotational resistance than screws.
fields.indications: The iFuse Implant System® is intended for sacroiliac fusion for conditions including sacroiliac joint dysfunction that is a direct result of sacroiliac joint disruption and degenerative sacroiliitis. This includes conditions whose symptoms began during pregnancy or in the peripartum period and have persisted postpartum for more than 6 months. The iFuse Implant System is also intended for sacroiliac fusion to augment immobilization and stabilization of the sacroiliac joint in skeletally mature patients undergoing sacropelvic fixation as a part of a lumbar or thoracolumbar fusion.
